verdict.rationale: MailerLite documents composing emails with three editors (drag-and-drop, Simple, custom HTML), and drafting, scheduling, sending, and cancelling campaigns. Dynamic segments exist, but the evidence never says a campaign can be targeted at a chosen segment or group, so the audience-selection step is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation of selecting a campaign's audience (segments/groups) during campaign setup, independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end compose→target→send/schedule loop.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can compose an email campaign, pick its audience, and send or schedule it — the arena's table-stakes loop

citations.quote: Three editors, a drag and drop editor, a distraction-free Simple editor and a custom HTML editor with live preview.
Create engaging, dynamic emails in minutes with our intuitive drag & drop email editor.
Draft, schedule, send, and cancel email campaigns, plus retrieve campaign reports and link clicks.
Dynamic segments that update as subscriber data changes.
